api.doc.info.description:
The Shelfline Field API lets you sync stores, products and field teams with your own systems, plan visits and read the surveys collected in stores.

Shelfline is a fictional company: this API exists to demonstrate an OpenAPI clean-up pipeline and a multilingual docs portal.
api.doc.security.basic.description: HTTP Basic authentication. Send `Authorization: Basic base64(username:password)` using an integration user created in the Shelfline admin.
api.doc.header.client.description: Name of your integration, used in audit logs and rate limiting (e.g. `erp-sync`).
api.doc.header.version.description: API version for v3 endpoints, as a release date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Ignored by v1.
api.doc.param.visit-ids.description: IDs of the visits to remove, comma-separated.
api.doc.error.v3.description: Error body returned by v3 endpoints.
api.doc.error.v3.details.description: Field-level problems, when the request body is invalid.
api.doc.error.legacy.description: Error body returned by legacy v1 endpoints.
api.doc.error.bad-request: The request is malformed or a field is invalid.

api.doc.error.rate-limited: Too many requests. Retry after the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.
